headline: Headwater Gold Signs Spring Peak Joint Venture Agreement with Newmont
summary: Headwater Gold Inc. has entered into a joint venture agreement with Newmont Corporation regarding the Spring Peak project.

headline: Nevada Gold Mines Acquires Gold Exploration Projects from Ridgeline Minerals
summary: Nevada Gold Mines LLC, a joint venture between Newmont and Barrick, has acquired four gold exploration projects from Ridgeline Minerals Corp. in an all-cash transaction.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Announces Quarterly Dividend
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. has announced its quarterly dividend declaration.

headline: Newmont and Barrick Resolve Nevada Gold Mines Disputes
summary: Newmont Corporation and Barrick Gold Corporation have reached an agreement to resolve all outstanding disputes related to their Nevada Gold Mines (NGM) joint venture.

headline: Newmont and Barrick Settle Nevada Gold Mines Disputes
summary: Newmont and Barrick have reached a settlement to resolve all outstanding disputes regarding their Nevada Gold Mines joint venture, including a $1.95 billion cash payment from Newmont.

headline: Berenberg Updates Wheaton Precious Metals Forecasts After 'Record' Q2
summary: Berenberg has updated its financial forecasts for Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. following the company's record-breaking second quarter of 2026 and reiterated its 'Buy' rating.

headline: i-80 Gold Corp. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results
summary: i-80 Gold Corp. announced its financial and operating results for the second quarter of 2026, highlighting increased gold production and continued advancement of its development projects.

headline: Berenberg Updates Wheaton Precious Metals Forecasts Following Q2 Results
summary: Berenberg issued an updated research note on Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. following the company's second-quarter 2026 earnings report, maintaining a 'Buy' rating.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Announces $40 Million Funding for Salobo CPF Project
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals has agreed to provide $40 million to VBM to partially fund the Salobo CPF Project in exchange for replacing future milestone payments under their existing streaming agreement.

headline: Headwater Gold Signs New Earn-In Agreement with Newmont on the Jupiter Project
summary: Headwater Gold Inc. has entered into a new earn-in agreement with Newmont Corporation for the Jupiter gold project in Nevada.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals to Provide $40 Million Funding for Salobo CPF Project
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals has agreed to provide $40 million to Vale Base Metals (VBM) to support the Salobo Coarse Particle Flotation (CPF) project in Brazil, replacing future milestone payments.

headline: AngloGold Ashanti to Increase Strategic Investment in Thesis Gold & Silver
summary: AngloGold Ashanti has agreed to purchase additional securities in Thesis Gold & Silver Inc. for approximately C$58.5 million, increasing its stake in the company from 5% to 9.7%.

headline: StrikePoint Gold to Acquire Northumberland Gold Project from Newmont
summary: StrikePoint Gold Inc. has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire the Northumberland Gold Project in Nevada from subsidiaries of Newmont Corporation for US$70 million in cash.

headline: Wheaton's New CEO Sees Billion-Dollar Streaming Era
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals' new CEO highlights the company's strategic focus on large-scale streaming deals, specifically citing the Antamina agreement as a catalyst for increased cash flow and future acquisition capacity.

headline: Gold.com Announces Fiscal Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2026 Earnings Conference Call
summary: Gold.com, Inc. (NYSE: GOLD) has scheduled a conference call for September 2, 2026, to discuss its financial results for the fiscal fourth quarter and full year ended June 30, 2026.

headline: Newmont to Sell Northumberland Gold Project to StrikePoint
summary: Newmont Corporation has agreed to sell its Northumberland Gold Project in Nevada to StrikePoint Gold Inc. for $70 million in upfront cash.

headline: Gold Terra Resource Corp. Announces Drill Programs at Con Mine Option
summary: Gold Terra Resource Corp. has announced plans for two concurrent drill programs at the Con Mine property, which is held under option from a subsidiary of Newmont Corporation.

headline: Agnico Eagle Announces Strategic Investment in Radisson Mining Resources Inc.
summary: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited has entered into a subscription agreement to acquire a stake in Radisson Mining Resources Inc. for approximately C$57.2 million to support underground exploration at the O'Brien Gold Project.

headline: Newmont Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial and Operational Results
summary: Newmont Corporation announced its second-quarter 2026 financial results, highlighting 1.3 million ounces of gold production, $2.2 billion in free cash flow, and $1.9 billion returned to shareholders.

headline: AngloGold Ashanti to Process All Brazilian Gold Concentrate Domestically
summary: AngloGold Ashanti has announced a strategic shift to process all of its gold concentrate produced in Brazil within the country.

headline: U.S. GoldMining Inc. Provides Update on 2026 Exploration Program at Whistler Project
summary: U.S. GoldMining Inc., a subsidiary of GoldMining Inc., reported progress on its 2026 diamond core drilling campaign and federal policy engagement at the Whistler Gold-Copper Project in Alaska.
